lyrics.original: Back in the town, 여기 드디어
lyrics.romanization: back in the town, yeogi deudieo
lyrics.english: Back in the town, Finally, here I am

lyrics.original: 지면 위에 발을 딛어, 내 집이야
lyrics.romanization: jimyeon wie bareul dideo, nae jibiya
lyrics.english: With my feet back on the ground, This is my home

lyrics.original: 내 말 끝나기 무섭게, 모두 Hit me up
lyrics.romanization: nae mal kkeunnagi museopge, modu hit me up

lyrics.english: Ready to pop off!, Let it all pour out, It feels just like a jackpot

lyrics.english: Like Piñata, When I count to three, strike, Scream out right now
